reason: A DSH plugin packaging a model-agnostic cognitive control suite that adds a J-Space agent preset, injects its entry protocol into the system prompt, and supports on-demand loading of related modules and references.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 添加 J-Space Cognition Suite 智能体预设，通过系统提示词注入认知控制入口协议，并按需加载相关模块与参考资料。
summaries.en: Adds a J-Space Cognition Suite agent preset to DSH, injecting its cognitive-control entry protocol into the system prompt and loading related modules and references on demand.

capabilities: Installs a DSH skill and agent preset
Injects an entry protocol into the DSH system prompt
Loads modules and references on demand through skill tools
